title: The verifier's delivery check beside an author panel (definition version 7 with a fixed electorate, ballot version 4, delivery records version 2): definitions, clocks, boards carrying both panels' transcripts, the author approvals, ballots and share receipts, and the pinned default panel, with the rows 5.9, 6.3, 7.1 to 7.3 and 8.5, the report's delivery and the counted ballots' entries
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-delivery-v2-author-vectors.py, from verifier-ballots-v4-author-vectors.py, verifier-ceremony-vectors.py, ceremony-vectors.py, delivery-vectors.py, delivery-v2-vectors.py, intake-v4-vectors.py and verifier-openings-vectors.py (independent Python implementations); the ballot records are verifier-ballots-v4-author-definition-v7.json's

cases.description: Every registered seat of both panels (default seats 1 to 3, author seats 1 and 2) receipts each of the three ballots in segment 3, so every ballot is delivered and counted. Beside them in segment 3: a receipt from author seat 3, which isn't registered (delivery-seat, panel 2); author seat 1's receipt for the cell-0 ballot signed with default seat 1's key (share-receipt, no signer); default seat 1's receipt carrying author seat 1's share hash, signed by default seat 1 (share-receipt with signer 1: a receipt is checked against its own panel's share hash); and an author seat 2 receipt naming another definition (delivery-stray).

Every default seat receipts each ballot in segment 3, but the author panel's seats don't all: author seat 2 never receipts the cell-1 ballot, and author seat 1's receipt for the tier-2 ballot is boarded in segment 52, after the delivery window's last segment s_D = 51 but at or below the floor (delivery-late). Neither ballot is delivered, so neither is counted, each missing its author seat; the cell-0 ballot is. A ballot opens only with both panels' thresholds, so the default panel's receipts alone never deliver one (T-37, T-54).
Only the default panel's seats receipt, every ballot in segment 3: each ballot misses author seats 1 and 2, so none is counted.
Every author seat receipts each ballot in segment 3, but default seat 3 never receipts the cell-0 ballot: that ballot misses it and isn't counted, as without an author panel, while the others are.
The delivered case's receipts with only author seat 1's approval, short of q_A = 2: the author panel's key set isn't approved, so nothing is decided; 5.9 and every row after it are not reached.

The delivered case's receipts with no approvals record on the copy: the author panel's key set isn't approved, so no ballot is admitted and nothing is decided; 5.9 and every row after it are not reached.

Definition version 7 under a fixed electorate, beside the author panel: every registered seat of both panels receipts the cell-1 and tier-2 ballots in segment 3, but its receipts for the cell-0 ballot name that ballot's fields under the same election read as version 6 (that reading's hash in each statement and in the ballot hash it names): each is delivery-stray, so the cell-0 ballot misses every seat of both panels and isn't counted; the others are.
